titulo_es: Passive voice: who receives the action

bloques.titulo: The passive puts in the foreground the person who receives the action; the agent can be marked with the action or the agent.
texto: Group 1: u → a + ∞; group 2: remove hy + hy hy; hy hue → hy; hy-hy-hy. Do not confuse passive with potential: context and particles help.
The building was designed by an architect.
The person next door stepped on my foot (and affected me).

frases.ja: この たてもの は せっけいしゃ に よって つくられました。
frases.es: Este edificio fue diseñado por un arquitecto.
frases.en: This building was designed by an architect.

frases.ja: わたし は となり の ひと に あし を ふまれました。
frases.es: La persona de al lado me pisó el pie (y me afectó).
frases.en: The person next door stepped on my foot (and it affected me).
